entries.def: a borer, gimlet , Lat. terebra, (Odyssey by Homer) (ML)

1. delightsome, delightful, pleasant, agreeable, glad , (Theognis Elegiacus), etc.; τὸ τερπνόν delight, pleasure , (Thucydides); τὰ τερπνά delights, pleasures , (Xenophon Historicus) 
2. of persons, αὑτῷ τερπνός with joy to himself, (Sophocles Tragicus):—;comparative and Sup. τερπνότερος, -ότατος, (Theognis Elegiacus); later, -ιστος:—;adverb τερπνῶς, (Theognis Elegiacus) (ML)

1. to satisfy, delight, gladden, cheer , (Homer), attic:—;absolute to give delight , (Odyssey by Homer); τὰ τέρποντα delights , (Sophocles Tragicus) 
2. Pass. and Mid., 
3. with genitive rei, to have full enjoyment of a thing, have enough of it, (Homer); metaphorically, τεταρπώμεσθα γόοιο let us take our fill of lamentation, (Homer) 
4. to enjoy oneself, make merry , with dative modi, φόρμιγγι, μύθοισι, etc.,…
enjoyment, delight , τινός from or in a thing, (Hesiod):—;absolute gladness, joy, delight, pleasure , (Theognis Elegiacus) (ML)
